text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I've always been
completely “alone”.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am...
exactly the kind of girl you know me to be."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I was meant to quietly... alone,
fade into the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: However...—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You...
you found me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, I woke up feeling the chilly air.
The forecast said it would be cloudy all day,
so while the sky wasn't clear, my spirits were high.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After all, starting today...
full-scale training begins with the Umamusume
I signed a contract with.
choice_data_list: (Alright, let's put our all into the preparations.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I'd like to measure your current abilities.
Tracsen Academy is well-equipped, so we have every tool we could possibly need.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: (Next I need to bring out the hurdles too...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Um...
choice_data_list: （……Huh? Did something just…）

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...You're finally looking at me.
choice_data_list: Still...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Good morning,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She is Still in Love.
Starting today, she is my trainee Umamusume, aiming for the Twinkle Series alongside me.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I didn't notice.
I'm sorry, I didn't realize.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am fine.
I am quite used to it...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You're preparing for training, correct?
Please allow me to assist you.
choice_data_list: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love is a reserved, somewhat inconspicuous Umamusume.
Aside from that, she's an ordinary, kind girl, but—
choice_data_list: (There's another side to her that's not so “proper”…)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A sudden chill ran down my spine. Flashing back like a bolt of lightning was the night I first met her...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Let us devour even the moon itself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"A-ha-ha! AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
AAAAAAHHHHHHAAAAAA.........!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love's other side.
That is... a beast-like face shown only by "instinct."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "wild blood" dormant within her.
Once it awakens—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Let me sip... your power!!
—Until every drop of your blood runs dryyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An otherworldly, monstrous presence appears.
...Yet, toward that run which terrifies all who behold it—
choice_data_list: (I can't help it—I'm drawn to her...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It remains burned into my mind forever, refusing to fade. Her run... her fierce spirit... that sheer dread... engraved deep within me—
—Mr./Ms.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right?
...You look a little pale...
choice_data_list: Are you alright...? Shall we keep getting ready?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her reserved, rational side, and her instinctive side.
With such difficult dual natures to control,
she must have struggled far more than I could imagine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now that we've formed a contract as Trainer and trainee, I carry a huge responsibility for her future. In other words, there's only one thing I must do—
choice_data_list: (No matter what she's like—I'll support her.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"—Well then, that will be all for today...
Thank you for your hard work."
choice_data_list: Yeah, see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our first training session after teaming up ended peacefully, with no sign of her instincts awakening.
As long as we avoid the "triggers," it seems everything will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The conditions for awakening her instincts...
All we know right now is: "competing against the strong"
and "a full moon night"—these two.
choice_data_list: (That said, it doesn't change the fact that it's out of control)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still in Love is in an unstable state. We will need a specialized regimen moving forward that accounts for every possible scenario.
choice_data_list: (Alright, let me stay behind a bit and think it over.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Pitter... patter...
*shhhhhh*...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—While focusing on my work,
before I knew it, the night had grown quite late.
It's almost curfew time for the Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Whoa, and now it's raining...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, there's a spare umbrella in the Trainer's room.
Having packed up my things, I turned around to head home, when—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I do apologize.
I didn't mean to startle you...
choice_data_list: S-Since when have you been here...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
A little... for about an hour now.
I'm sorry, I did knock, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You were so focused, so...
I held back to avoid disturbing you.
choice_data_list: Didn't you go back to the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes. But... it felt like you were still here.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It is a sudden rain, after all.
Just to make sure you don't get wet, even by chance...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I brought an umbrella, but...
Was it unnecessary of me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still in Love offered a wry smile as she noticed the umbrella in her hand. I felt genuinely grateful for her kindness. But at the same time—
choice_data_list: Thanks for being so thoughtful. But listen, Still...
Thanks for the consideration. But you see, Still...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: You don't have to do this kind of thing, okay?
You don't have to do this kind of thing, okay?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I am so terribly sorry.
I've really caused you trouble—
choice_data_list: Because you're more important than I am.
After all, you're more important than I am, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Your hair's a little wet... Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
I'm fine...
choice_data_list: Good. I'll walk you back to the dorms, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...I went to pick them up,
but in the end, they ended up seeing me off.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(“See ya tomorrow, Still.”
...he says.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(“See you tomorrow, Still.”
...she says.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
("See you tomorrow"...
Tomorrow... I'll get to see you again...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I think something has gone wrong with me.
Whenever I think of them... it hurts, yet I feel so happy.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (...Just kidding. I've always been weird... Yet that person... accepted me.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Your instinct is... terrifyingly beautiful."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "‘Your instincts are—scarily beautiful.’"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(That detestable form of mine... this instinct...
Only they called it beautiful...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Because you are with me.
I can keep running... into the future.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(In the Twinkle Series, the stage of my dreams...
A mouthwatering race... against the strongest—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why I want it.
Please... stay by my side, forever."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: F　o　r　e　v　e　r　a　n　d　e　v　e　r
